Where Izzy rides

91 resorts. Say the name — Izzy knows it.

91 mountains across the US and Canada — the IKON and EPIC resorts, plus a growing set of select independents. Pick yours in the app and Izzy answers with that mountain's lifts, trails, grooming and conditions.

IKONEPICINDY Badges show the pass the resort belongs to. INDY = an independent, on its own pass.
